key_finding: Defined probiotics as live microorganisms that confer a health benefit on the host when administered in adequate amounts; emphasized strain-specific benefits and the need for clinical evidence.

dosage_tested: Vitamin D2 or vitamin D3; daily intake levels based on age and clinical circumstances
key_finding: Guideline recommends serum 25(OH)D testing for at-risk patients and treatment with vitamin D2/D3 for deficiency; supplementation supports bone health and calcium absorption.

study_type: Rapid evidence assessment of randomized and controlled studies
dosage_tested: Supplemental tyrosine; specific dosage not reported in summary
key_finding: Did not support a strong recommendation for physical performance under stressful physical conditions; weak recommendation favored tyrosine for cognitive performance under stress.

dosage_tested: Condensed tannin extract from quebracho trees; tested levels not specified in summary
key_finding: Quebracho tannin extract did not reduce methane emissions in cattle at the tested levels.
Magnesium supplementation significantly improves sleep quality and reduces insomnia severity, especially in older adults.

dosage_tested: Standardized Bacopa monnieri extract; dose not reported in summary
key_finding: In healthy older adults, Bacopa monnieri improved delayed verbal recall and Stroop-related performance versus placebo, with trends toward improved anxiety and depression scores and generally acceptable tolerability.
Supplementation with the extract complex significantly improved skin hydration and reduced signs of aging, likely due to enhanced collagen production.

dosage_tested: High-concentration full-spectrum ashwagandha root extract; exact dose not specified in summary
key_finding: Ashwagandha reduced stress and anxiety scores in stressed adults and decreased serum cortisol versus placebo.

EPA and DHA are essential long-chain omega-3 PUFAs with roles across the lifespan, supporting fetal neuronal/retinal/immune development and cardiovascular and cognitive function through anti-inflammatory and membrane-related effects.

study_type: Phase III randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, parallel-group study
key_finding: Rhodiola rosea SHR-5 reduced stress-related fatigue, improved concentration-related attention metrics, and improved cortisol response to awakening stress versus placebo; no serious extract-related adverse effects were reported.
Magnesium supplementation improved subjective sleep measures in older adults with insomnia; proposed mechanism involves NMDA antagonism and GABA activity.
Acute L-theanine plus caffeine significantly improved task-switching attention versus placebo, but did not significantly improve subjective alertness or intersensory attention.
Zinc is essential for immune and metabolic function, but supplementation has a narrow safety margin; excess zinc can cause copper deficiency, while deficiency affects a substantial global population.

study_type: Cochrane review of randomized, placebo-controlled studies
key_finding: Evidence suggested benefit on memory and behavior outcomes in short- to medium-term settings; no clear pooled benefit for attention; generally well tolerated.

Creatine supplementation increases muscle creatine and phosphocreatine stores and is associated with improved performance; ~70% of reviewed studies reported significant performance benefits, with 5-15% increases in maximal power/strength and greater gains in strength and fat-free mass during training.
